### 🚀 Project Experience

#### 1. [PinEase](https://github.com/praxpur/PinEase) 🪑
- 🦴 MediaPipe-based sitting posture and eye-health assistant, available as both a web app and a Tauri v2 Windows desktop app
- 🤖 Runs local vision inference in a Web Worker, combining front/side personal calibration, smoothing, and duration thresholds for posture alerts
- 📊 Integrates a Pomodoro timer, sedentary and eye-care reminders, historical trends, and data export, built with Vue 3, TypeScript, ECharts, and IndexedDB

#### 2. [ACE](https://github.com/praxpur/Ace) 🎓
- 🖥️ Unified desktop application combining Chaoxing (Xuexitong) and Zhihuishu course tasks, with isolated account, configuration, and runtime management per platform
- 🎬 Supports course outlines, video selection, playback queues, progress tracking, and real-time logs, along with light/dark/system themes and Windows tray persistence
- 💻 Built with Python, Vue 3, TypeScript, Element Plus, PyWebView, and Playwright, integrating core automation workflows from `chaoxing-gui` and `Treehouse-Course` while preserving upstream licenses

#### 3. [Counselor Offline Training Platform](https://github.com/praxpur/CounselorTrainingPlatform) 🏫
- 📋 Built with a native WeChat Mini Program, Node.js, and SQLite, supporting event publishing, registration, attendance confirmation, training record review, and personnel management
- 📊 Implements annual training-hour statistics, rankings, and Excel export, using database transactions and unique constraints to prevent overbooking and duplicate registrations
- 🛠️ Currently in development with system and concurrent load test scripts included; production authentication and deployment are planned

#### 4. [MediaPipe-CN](https://github.com/praxpur/MediaPipe-CN) 📖
- 🌐 Simplified Chinese mirror of the Google AI Edge MediaPipe documentation, covering learning resources for both Solutions and Framework
- 🖼️ Provides Markdown documentation, locally hosted images, and a navigable reader interface for both online browsing and offline reading
- 🐍 Includes scraping and conversion scripts that retain original URLs, update timestamps, and content licenses for easy comparison and maintenance

#### 5. Personal Blogs & Templates 📝
- **[PraxBlog](https://github.com/praxpur/PraxBlog)**: A Material Design 3 blog template built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS v4, customizable through site configuration
- **[M3Blog](https://github.com/praxpur/M3Blog)**: Built with Vue 3, Material Web, Node.js, and Express, supporting Markdown posts, search, comments, likes, a guestbook, and light/dark themes

#### 6. [Koi2Notion](https://github.com/praxpur/koi2notion) 📓
- 📖 Python utility for syncing Kindle highlights and notes (`My Clippings.txt`) to a Notion database, with Chinese clipping parsing and author metadata syncing
- 🔄 Implements incremental sync via file signatures, title matching, and deduplication against existing entries, associating notes with highlights by page/location range
- 🐍 Provides a file-watching mode and a `requests`-based Notion client with retry handling for rate limits and service errors

#### 7. [AutoColor](https://github.com/praxpur/AutoColor) 🎨
- 🖼️ Windows 11 system tray utility built with C# and WinForms that toggles system and app themes based on custom schedules or local sunrise/sunset times
- 🌅 Uses offline solar position calculation and one-shot timers to schedule the next switch, with optional launch at login for the current user

#### 8. Other Utilities & Programming Practice 🧰
- **[DormKeeper](https://github.com/praxpur/DormKeeper)**: Python utility for archiving authorized dorm attendance snapshots, with a GUI, year/month organization, incremental downloads, and video generation
- **[PV-Park](https://github.com/praxpur/PV-Park)**: Parking lot management system written in C using linked lists and file I/O for vehicle check-in/out, billing, search, and revenue statistics

#### 10. Open-Source Contributions 🌍
- 🔄 Submitted a [Notion note-sync PR to Readest](https://github.com/readest/readest/pull/5949) supporting automatic/manual syncing of highlights and notes, incremental updates, deduplication, and retries
- 🐞 Filed [bug reports and UX improvement suggestions for Readest](https://github.com/readest/readest/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20author%3Apraxpur) across Windows, Android, and Linux
- 📖 Contributed Chinese localization improvements to [Calibre-Web-Automated](https://github.com/crocodilestick/Calibre-Web-Automated/pull/1151), refining UI copy and user prompts
